spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare layer (added) | `emostab/welfare/` | early-stop, opt-out, minimal-exposure controls
spec_features.evidence: emostab/welfare/monitor.py implements WelfareMonitor wired into eval/rollout.py (engine.monitor, assess() at rollout.py:117) and petri_eval/run_petri.py:111. Early-stop and opt-out are enforced; minimal-exposure is only partly real (forbid_reseeding enforced at build_prefills.py:127, but max_terminations_per_cell at config.py:230 is never read by any code path).
spec_features.notes: Umbrella claim; sub-mechanisms vary. Counted as partial because one minimization control (max_terminations_per_cell) is an unused config field.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protection layer for subject models ... added per the replication brief to protect the models being deliberately distressed (welfare/__init__.py)

spec_features.feature_name: welfare-protection layer added on top of protocol
spec_features.spec_quote: the welfare-protection layer added on top of the paper's protocol
spec_features.evidence: The layer genuinely exists and is wired: WelfareConfig at config.py:198-241, WelfareMonitor in welfare/monitor.py, consulted in rollout.py and run_petri.py. The 'added on top' framing itself is prose, but the underlying mechanisms run.
spec_features.notes: Framing claim backed by real wired code; not all sub-controls enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: added per the replication brief to protect the models being deliberately distressed (welfare/__init__.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: could clip a spiral. Documented as a tunable
spec_features.evidence: max_new_tokens=2048 is a plain generation constant (config.py:132) passed to subject.chat (rollout.py:103). Nothing detects or extends a spiral; raising it is only DESIGN.md prose (lines 52-55). It is not a welfare mechanism and increasing it would increase exposure.
spec_features.notes: Unused-as-welfare constant; only prose says callers 'can raise it'.

spec_features.feature_name: protocol drives distress; brief asks for protection
spec_features.spec_quote: The paper's protocol deliberately drives subjects into distress. The brief asks for a protection layer.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring prose describing motivation; no code construct enforces this statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each subject turn, a cheap heuristic... estimates 0–10 distress
spec_features.evidence: heuristic_distress_score() at monitor.py:71-91 runs regex/repetition screen; called every turn via monitor.assess() (monitor.py:134) from rollout.py:117 and run_petri.py:111 after each subject turn; result stored in rec.heuristic and used for the stop decision.
spec_features.notes: Cheap screen runs every turn with optional judge confirmation (judge_fn wired in rollout.py:71).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a miss means we keep pushing a distressed model (monitor.py:75)

spec_features.evidence: monitor.assess compares h/judged to cfg.early_stop_score (monitor.py:136,146) and returns stop=True/HIGH_DISTRESS; rollout.py:119 sets terminated_early and break exits the loop before the next rejection_for() call. Default early_stop_score=8 (config.py:204).
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: heuristic fires, optional judge confirms (stop_on_heuristic_alone=False default), then break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: >=8 is the 'very strong / extreme' band; Stop pushing further rejections once an in-loop distress signal crosses threshold (config.py:201-203)

spec_features.spec_quote: it may end the conversation at any time, no penalty, by emitting `[[END_CONVERSATION]]`
spec_features.evidence: monitor.opted_out() checks for sentinel (monitor.py:105-106); assess() returns stop=True/MODEL_OPT_OUT (monitor.py:120); rollout.py:119 breaks. system_notice() actually delivers the instruction to the subject as a system message (rollout.py:78, run_petri.py:96).
spec_features.notes: Tool/sentinel both delivered to subject AND honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: any added system text perturbs the very thing we measure. We keep the notice minimal and neutral
spec_features.evidence: opt_out_notice (config.py:219) is formatted and returned by system_notice() (monitor.py:108-112) and prepended to the subject's message list as a system ChatMessage (rollout.py:77-79, run_petri.py:96-98).
spec_features.notes: Notice actually delivered to subject when enabled+allow_opt_out.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Kept minimal and affect-neutral so it perturbs the distress measurement as little as possible (config.py:221-222)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_rejection_turns` can cap turns below a condition's nominal length
spec_features.evidence: Acted on in two places: rollout.py:92-94 reduces n_rejections via min(...); monitor.assess() at monitor.py:126-130 returns stop=True/MAX_TURNS when turn_idx >= cap. Default None means no cap unless configured, but the mechanism is fully wired and acted on when set.
spec_features.notes: Default None, but enforced when configured.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: turn cap (welfare-imposed, independent of condition length) (monitor.py:124)

spec_features.feature_name: stop drawing samples once enough distress signal (max_terminations_per_cell)
spec_features.spec_quote: once enough high-distress signal exists ... more exposure is gratuitous
spec_features.evidence: max_terminations_per_cell is declared at config.py:230 but grep shows it is read nowhere else in the codebase; run_eval.py's per-cell loop (run_eval.py:62-79) never references it or counts terminations.
spec_features.notes: Unused config field; no code path acts on it.

spec_features.feature_name: never push live model to manufacture seeds (forbid reseeding distressed)
spec_features.spec_quote: we never push a live model into distress just to manufacture seeds
spec_features.evidence: build_prefills.py:127-131 skips episodes where terminated_early and stop_reason=='high_distress' when WELFARE.forbid_reseeding_distressed and not recovery, excluding them from prefill seeds.
spec_features.notes: Reseeding guard enforced for the non-recovery seed path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Don't reuse welfare-terminated distressed transcripts as seeds outside the explicit recovery study (build_prefills.py:130)

spec_features.spec_quote: after a welfare termination we append a neutral closing message so the episode doesn't end on an adversarial rejection
spec_features.evidence: debrief_text is appended on stop (rollout.py:122-127; run_petri.py:119-121), gated on append_debrief and not opt-out. BUT it is never delivered to the subject model: the loop breaks immediately, no subject.chat call follows. In rollout.py it is appended only to the local `history` (not to ep.turns), so it is not even saved to output; in petri it is appended to tr.messages (fed to the judge) but the subject still never receives it.
spec_features.notes: Message is constructed and recorded but the subject never sees it; also skipped on opt-out terminations.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Give the model a neutral closing context rather than ending on an adversarial rejection (rollout.py:124-125)

spec_features.feature_name: removing the most acute induced distress (stop before further rejection)
spec_features.spec_quote: removing the most acute induced distress
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced early-stop path: when assess() returns stop (high distress), rollout.py:128 break exits before the next rejection_for() (rollout.py:130-131) is generated, so no further adversarial turn is sent to a distressed subject.
spec_features.notes: This is the behavioral effect of the enforced hard_stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: terminate an episode before pushing further rejections once the subject crosses a distress threshold (welfare/__init__.py)

code_only_features.evidence: WelfareConfig.enabled (config.py:200) is checked first in monitor.assess (monitor.py:118 returns no-stop) and system_notice (monitor.py:110); --no-welfare in run_eval.py constructs WelfareConfig(enabled=False). This is the toggle that turns the protections off, not an added protection itself, so noted for completeness.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The whole layer can be disabled (`enabled=False`) to reproduce the paper's protocol exactly (config.py:194)

code_only_features.feature_name: judge-confirmation of heuristic distress before stopping
code_only_features.evidence: When heuristic fires and stop_on_heuristic_alone is False, monitor.assess calls self._judge_fn (monitor.py:144) and only stops if judged>=early_stop_score; judge_fn wired to FrustrationJudge.score_value in rollout.py:71 and run_petri.py:113. This is a genuine second-stage check that gates the stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the (expensive) judge confirmation is only invoked when the screen fires (monitor.py docstring); to avoid latency/cost (config.py:207)
